protocol: Five-fold participant-held-out SEED-VII evaluation; familiar clips and sessions in all folds
generalization_target: unseen participants viewing familiar clips under the same session design; not unseen videos or sessions
dataset_application_scope: models trained and evaluated within SEED-VII using inherited architectures; not transfer of FACED-trained weights
ci_scope: conditional on fitted OOF models and sampled videos; importance averages saved feature permutations before participant resampling
importance_scope: model reliance under grouped feature permutation; not causal, not additive across overlapping groups; confidence intervals are pointwise descriptive intervals without multiplicity adjustment
null_scheme: source-condition block labels permuted with one shared assignment across participants and models, with full model refitting; preserves block-label counts, not clip-label counts
source_block_note: The two mixed-condition sources, Under the Hawthorn Tree and You Are My Life, each contribute separate sadness and happiness blocks; those blocks are separate permutation units. Blocks preserve dependence among same-condition excerpts, not all dependence between excerpts of a mixed-condition source.
session_scope: Condition frequencies differ by session; this block null does not preserve session-by-condition counts. Participant-held-out performance alone does not establish session-independent emotion information.
null_inference_policy: p=(1 + number of null scores >= observed)/100; requires all permutation IDs 1..99 for that model at the primary seed
holm_scope: all prespecified primary models; calculated only after every model's complete null is available

session_control.bootstrap_scope: Participant resampling conditional on this fixed session/clip design; identical participant labels yield degenerate control-score intervals
session_control.definition: Train-fold balanced-accuracy-optimal prediction from session identity alone; deterministic class-order ties; no EEG input
session_control.generalization: Unseen participants viewing familiar clips in familiar sessions
session_control.null_scope: Same 99 source-by-condition label permutations as the EEG models; block-class counts preserved, session-class counts not preserved
session_control.scope: Diagnostic for the condition imbalance across familiar recording sessions; not a conditional permutation test or evidence of emotion-specific information
